doc: Points exactly ON cell corners (fractional part 0) up to +-5000: F1 is the distance from the corner to the nearest jittered feature of the 27-cell neighborhood. Exercises the exact-integer path of floor() and the cell indices past the 1024 wrap. Default tolerance. The permutation input plan<i>.perm is the draw as recorded (256 entries for Perlin3, 1024 for Worley3); the kernel indexes it DOUBLED, concat(perm, perm) (512 or 2048 entries, so p[i + 256] = p[i]): a port that indexes the stored array directly runs off its end (see the .table cases).
